_doc: Choices that must be made EXPLICITLY per feature kind, each with a default so the agent proceeds without interrogating the user. Format: [decision, options, deciding factor, DEFAULT].
auth: Session mechanism
opaque server session | stateless JWT | JWT+refresh rotation
does revocation need to be immediate?
opaque server session in an httpOnly cookie — immediate revocation, simplest correct option for a first-party app
Password hashing
argon2id | bcrypt | scrypt
is a modern KDF library available on the runtime?
argon2id; bcrypt (cost>=12) if argon2 is unavailable
MFA
none | TOTP | WebAuthn | SMS
what does the threat model require?
TOTP, behind a feature flag, shipped after core login works
Rate limiting location
app middleware | gateway/WAF | both
is there a gateway already?
gateway if one exists, plus a per-account app-level counter for lockout
Identity source
local credentials | OAuth/OIDC only | both
who are the users?
both, with local as the fallback; OAuth added as a second ADR not a rewrite
Session storage
redis | database table | signed cookie only
is a shared store available in the deploy target?
redis if present, otherwise a database table; never a signed cookie alone if A1 requires revocation
crud: can two users edit the same record?
optimistic with a version column — cheap, and it surfaces conflicts instead of losing writes
hard delete | soft delete | archive table
is there an audit or undo requirement?
soft delete with a partial index excluding deleted rows
cursor/keyset — offset silently duplicates and skips rows under concurrent writes
all three: DTO at the edge, invariants in the service, constraints in the schema as the backstop
payment: integer minor units | decimal type | float
integer minor units; float is never acceptable
client-supplied idempotency key, stored with the result
trust webhooks | poll | webhooks + scheduled reconcile
what happens if a webhook is lost?
webhooks plus a scheduled reconcile — webhooks alone lose events
upload: direct-to-storage presigned | through the app server
file size and app memory budget
presigned direct-to-storage; the app never buffers the bytes
content sniff on the server, with an allowlist
can an upload outlive its record?
reaper job on a TTL — simplest thing that actually converges
search: database full-text first; a dedicated index only once a measured limit is hit
synchronous | async with stated lag | read-through
can a user not see their own write?
async with an explicitly documented lag, plus read-your-own-writes for the author
realtime: SSE for server-to-client only; WebSocket when the client must push
what does a lost or duplicated message cost?
at-least-once with idempotent application — exactly-once is usually a mirage
migration: is there more than one running instance?
expand/contract — old and new code must both work against the intermediate schema
inline in migration | separate idempotent job
separate idempotent, resumable job; never inline on a large table
integration: fail closed | fail open | degrade to cached
what is worse: wrong answer or no answer?
fail closed for writes and authorization, degrade to cached for reads
none | fixed | exponential with jitter and cap
exponential with jitter and a cap, retrying only 5xx/429/timeouts
